title: Multi-Repository Security Analysis with CodeRabbit Secure
text: An application can have an authentication check and still expose data if a caller can bypass the service that enforces it. When the services and deployment settings live in separate repositories, spotting that gap requires examining how they work together. In a microservices application, the API gateway and orders service might live in separate repositories. The gateway checks a user's token and passes their ID to the orders service, which uses it to return that user's orders. If a caller can reach the orders service directly, they could send someone else's ID and access their orders.
